thread:
ellie (prod): quick sync: customers said the private setup wizard's network step is confusing. they want clearer next steps when checks fail. can we propose a compact pattern?
max (design): thinking: top-line status row with small summary + 2 CTAs: 'Run checks' and 'Quick fixes'. keep details collapsed. visual: status pill + "2 required checks failing" copy.
rui (eng): backend: we can return probe-level metadata (required/optional, weight, human_label). suggest UI groups required first. also recommend caching last result for 5 minutes to avoid repeated probes.
nina (a11y): accessible pattern: use a live region for status changes, but only polite for in-progress and assertive for new failures. ensure the summary row is a heading for SR navigation.
ellie (prod): copy ask: avoid jargon. change 'probe' to 'check' and 'failed' to 'issue detected'. so headline reads "2 required checks with issues".
max (design): good. inline 'Quick fixes' should open a tiny panel with 1-2 actionable steps and a 'View full report' link. keep the quick panel copy-first, advanced commands hidden under 'Advanced'.
rui (eng): implementation: quick panel will be client-side. advanced commands fetched only if user clicks 'View full report' or opts in to docs fetch. add `docs_fetch_enabled` flag default false for private installs.
nina (a11y): ensure 'Quick fixes' panel is keyboard reachable, focus moves into it and returns on close. use role="dialog" and aria-modal="false". copy buttons announce 'Copied' with aria-live.
ellie (prod): UX: show a small 'Stale' badge when cached results are older than 5m and surface 'Run checks' prominently. auto-run once if stale and user hasn't disabled auto-run.
max (design): spinner inside pill for 'Running checks' state. avoid animating entire row. respect prefers-reduced-motion.
rui (eng): performance note: batch probes server-side and provide a per-probe summary to avoid collapsing into a single ambiguous failure state. include a per-probe severity so UI can decide color.
nina (a11y): color alone can't convey severity: include icon + text. ensure contrast ratios meet AA at small sizes; current red needs darkening.
ellie (prod): final checklist for runbook update: 1) wording changes ('check'/'issue detected') 2) caching rules 3) quick fixes panel UX 4) aria-live rules 5) docs_fetch flag default. owners: max copy+visual, nina a11y sign-off, rui build. target: next sprint.
docs-bot: KB fetch successful for troubleshooting bundle.
max (design): I'll post Figma mock later today, will include microcopy variants for review.
rui (eng): will add localStorage caching and fetch-on-demand for advanced logs.
nina (a11y): will run VoiceOver pass after mocks are up. small nit: change 'View details' to be explicit 'View connectivity details'.
ellie (prod): thanks team, closing thread.
